history.overview: The Rift Breach is the catastrophic center of Discord corruption within the Wall of Slaughter, where planar tears destabilize the entire warfront.

timeline.name: First Planar Tear
timeline.description: A massive Discord rupture appeared, destabilizing Muramite fortifications.

timeline.name: Riftstorms
timeline.description: Planar storms formed, creating void pockets and unpredictable terrain shifts.

timeline.name: Muramite Response
timeline.description: Muramite warlocks attempted to contain the rifts but failed.

timeline.name: Total Instability
timeline.description: The Rift Breach became a catastrophic zone threatening the entire region.
